name: Atia Ahmed
quote: Amazing service from Xana Medtec staff! I have had the well women blood test from here, the staff went out of there way to make sure i was comfortable and well taken care of. The whole process from start to finish was quick, easy and effortless. Experienced staff, did not feel the needle what so ever. The report itself goes into depths of full body analysis, which is detailed, easy to understand and very informative. Overall great service and experience, worth every penny! Highly recommend to all women.
